name: Stackstorm
description: A neon falling-block puzzle game with a real Super Rotation System engine, a half-second slide window after every landing, and five distinct modes. Classic Marathon and Storm Mode build combos, back-to-back bonuses and a rechargeable surge; Sprint chases forty lines; Time Attack packs a score hunt into two minutes. Puzzle Journey adds 500 levels across ten themed worlds, each an endless score chase over a stone wall: fill the wells to bring the walls down, keep playing until the stack tops out, and beat the score target before you run out of room. Score above the goal for two and three stars. Themes, trophies, lifetime statistics and local saves work offline; Little Joy Arcade accounts sync the same payload across devices when signed in.
highlights: A proper SRS falling-block engine: seven-bag randomizer, hold, ghost, wall kicks and frame-rate-independent timing
The slide window: successful moves and rotations reset the lock timer for up to fifteen nudges after a piece lands
Five modes: Classic Marathon, Storm Mode, Sprint, Time Attack and the 500-level Puzzle Journey
Storm Mode charges a meter on clears and spends it on a twelve-second double-score surge
500 Journey levels across ten worlds, each an endless score chase whose stone wall the test suite proves is clearable
Eight colour themes, thirteen trophies and lifetime statistics saved locally and synced by the arcade client
Portrait-first touch pad with press-and-hold movement, optional swipe gestures, and full keyboard controls
Accessibility: reduced motion, high contrast, per-piece symbols beyond colour, adjustable DAS/ARR and separate volume sliders
Runs entirely in the browser with no downloads, no accounts required and a fully offline core game
howToPlay: Move with the arrow keys or the on-screen pad; rotate with Up/X and Z; hold with C or Shift; hard drop with Space.
When a piece lands it waits half a second before locking. Keep sliding or turning to nudge it into place — the glowing outline and the bar at the top of the board show the window.
Complete rows to clear them. Consecutive clears build a combo and four-line clears pay a back-to-back bonus.
In Storm Mode, clear lines to charge the meter, then press S or tap SURGE for twelve seconds of double points.
In Puzzle Journey you play until the stack tops out: clear the stone walls by filling the wells, and beat the score target before you run out of room.
